'''Kenichi Maeyamada''' (Japanese: '''前山田健一''' ''Maeyamada Ken'ichi''), also known as '''Hyadain''' (Japanese: '''ヒャダイン''' ''Hyadain'') is a Japanese musician and one of the hosts of ''[[Meet Up at the Pokémon House?]]''.

==Biography==
Maeyamada was born on July 4, 1980, in {{wp|Sumiyoshi-ku, Osaka|Sumiyoshi-ku}}, {{wp|Osaka}}, {{wp|Osaka Prefecture}}, {{wp|Japan}}. He began his musical career in 2007, and revealed his identity as Hyadain in 2010.
